Additional Analyses

Sections below were not part of the required set. They are grouped here for easy review.

Synthetic Betting Strategies

What would participants have earned if they had allocated tokens purely by the expected values implied by their own Block 1 probabilities? None of these strategies requires knowing the outcome — only the participant’s own beliefs and the posted odds.

  • Equal Split — 100 tokens divided equally across all positive-EV matches
  • EV Proportional — 100 tokens split in proportion to each positive-EV match’s EV
  • Max EV Only — all 100 tokens on the single highest-EV match
Mean Final Tokens: Synthetic Strategies vs. Actual

Allocation Patterns

Two dimensions describe how tokens were spread: the number of matches receiving a bet, and the concentration of the allocation (HHI). These separate the four intuitive patterns — even across all matches, even across a few, heavy on one with a little elsewhere, and everything on one match.
